implementation_contract: Wrap only a synchronous outermost LocalEnvelope.from_payload call in a private context-local memo, reused by recursive calls and always reset in finally on success or BaseException. No public trusted/skip-validation parameter, no global persistent cache, no task/lease/runtime authority caching.

First perform existing strict _object(payload, OUTER_FIELDS) snapshot/copy; derive key from exact class identity plus full canonical JSON text of that copied envelope, including diagnostics, original_time, decision and transaction. No object-id-only, digest-only, semantic-projection-only or schema-only key.
Only publish an entry after every original validation and descendant check succeeds. Do not cache errors or in-progress entries; an incomplete entry is never a successful hit.

A hit constructs a fresh instance of the requested class using the same immutable _json string; do not return a previously exposed object or mutable payload. Preserve canonical bytes/digest and detached copies from all accessors.

Fixed production bound: at most 128 entries and 8 MiB total UTF-8 canonical key/result content accounting (count any separately retained text); once an entry would exceed a bound, validate normally without inserting it. No rejection, widening bounds, eviction-dependent safety, external writes or acceptance shortcut. Canonicalization still costs O(input bytes) per lookup and is not claimed eliminated.

Memo is private per top-level synchronous call, isolated across threads/contexts, not inherited as reusable success across top-level calls. Class is part of key. Retain full checks even for equal semantic projection with different diagnostics/evidence.

ROOT review must confirm semantic validators remain unchanged and cached values carry no live authority. Any need to change replay logic, input schema, observer, timing, other product modules or error policy is new scope requiring Astra.

seed.selection: changed_payload (accepted full local promotion history); baseline_payload may also be used

test_design: Use real pinned golden envelopes and real decoder; no calls to old test functions or live runtime fixtures. Count full semantic validations with a delegating spy that always invokes the original validator; record distinct full canonical envelope/class keys. The bounded seed must fit memo caps.

First assertion demonstrates actual duplicate successful validations on old source and requires no more than one full validation for each identical class/full-content envelope within one top-level decode. This deterministic assertion is the only expected RED, not a wall-time threshold or missing helper error.

GREEN proves exact input/serialized canonical bytes/digest plus independent frozen projection equivalence; original budgets, original_time, decision and transaction remain exact, registries unchanged/no authority created.

Check fresh instance identity and mutation isolation of returned payload copies; two distinct subclasses retain their requested type and separate cache keys; repeated top-level successful calls perform validation again.

Check real invalid nested decision/transaction, original reference, diagnostic shape and exhausted-budget variants still reject; full-content variations cannot reuse an earlier success. Use bounded spy-driven nested decode calls if needed to exercise same-scope valid-then-mutated input; never bypass original validators.

Check ordinary success and exception clear context; subsequent valid decode works and no prior success is reused. Check two isolated contexts/threads with bounded joins and exact cleanup if threads are used.

Test entry/byte-cap fallback using private test monkeypatch of memo bounds to zero/small values; valid results stay exact, invalid values still reject, and overflow takes real full validation. Production caps stay fixed.
Save one finite case JSON containing source/seed hashes, raw output/digest, validation counters, invariants and actual exceptions; no profile sampling or polling added.
